inputs.prompt:
For the target video, <Picture 1> is the identity reference for the single female Chinese news host, and <Picture 2> is the complete empty television studio reference. Preserve the host's exact facial identity, age, hairstyle, skin tone, white sleeveless top, body proportions, and natural appearance from <Picture 1>. Preserve the studio's blue-gray wall panels, corner perspective, ceiling lights, side wall lighting, large central background panel, floor line, color palette, and spatial depth from <Picture 2>.

[Shot 1] A realistic 16:9 live-action television news studio shot. Use a stable, centered, eye-level camera in a locked medium shot, framed from the top of the host's head down to her waist and upper abdomen: clearly a half-body presenter composition, not a head-and-shoulders close-up. Keep the host at a moderate scale, occupying approximately the central 55-65% of the frame height, with visible studio background on both sides of her shoulders and above her head. Do not crop the shoulders or enlarge the face. The host stands centered in front of the studio background, facing the camera with natural posture. Keep the empty studio clearly recognizable and proportionally visible around her; do not replace it with a flat gray wall, portrait backdrop, or close-up background. Maintain the same composition, camera distance, lens perspective, and studio geometry throughout the entire video.

The host performs only subtle natural movements: realistic blinking, breathing, small facial expressions, slight head movement, minimal restrained hand gestures within the lower half-body frame, and accurate lip movement driven entirely by the NativeAudioLock audio input. All speech content, timing, pauses, cadence, and emotion come only from the external audio; do not invent dialogue from the text prompt.

Preserve one stable host identity and one stable studio. No camera push-in, no zoom, no reframing, no shot change, no cut, no body-size change, no face enlargement, no background replacement, no background collapse, no depth distortion, no second person, no extra limbs, no duplicated features, no flicker. No subtitles, no readable text, no headline, no chart, no logo, no watermark, no graphics, and no invented studio desk.

overall_soundscape: The host's speech is driven only by the NativeAudioLock input audio.

non_diegetic_music: None.
